pages.title: Cloud Siphon
pages.text: A slow pump for the nebula: touching a cloud, it draws that cloud's gas, and the cloud never notices.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Place it touching a Hydrogen, Oxygen or Dust Cloud block in the Accretion Frontier's nebula: it draws that cloud's gas, slowly and for ever. The cloud is not used up.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Hydrogen, Molecular Cloud, Oxygen.
